geometry.scope: B0 cross-section only, fixed uploaded midrib and all wind attributes; no additional distal roll

sky.model: spherical single-scattering Rayleigh/Mie/ozone atmosphere; multi-thermal, entrained volume cumulus
sky.cloudQuadrature: conservative max-mip weather bounds plus one-segment margin, fixed per-pixel interleaved-gradient offset
sky.cloudShapeModel: legacy capped column0; Gaussian thermal1; primary3D Worley puffs and continuous liquid-water density2

current.model: prescribed moist parcel LCL plus kinematic cumulus; no atmospheric fluid/forecast solve

target.model: prescribed moist parcel LCL plus kinematic cumulus; no atmospheric fluid/forecast solve

units.windDirection: degrees clockwise from +Z; null follows update wind

limits: LCL is a surface-parcel estimate, not a sounding
Cloud coverage is independently prescribed ascent availability
No precipitation, prognostic humidity, CAPE or Navier–Stokes solve

night.coordinates: +X east,+Y up,-Z north; geographic azimuth north clockwise; worldToEQJ applies inverse heading; standard refraction is Astronomy Engine normal

interpolation.moonAndSun: normalized vector interpolation between exact topocentric endpoints

limits: Astronomy Engine nominal arcminute-class; not a measurement-grade ephemeris
standard refraction uses a prescribed atmosphere, not current humidity sounding
historical UTC/UT1 and proper motion are approximations
night.starMap: NASA SVS4851 no-HIP/Tycho background + HIP/Tycho8.5 point kernels + diffuse complementary aggregate

starField.model: HIP/Tycho magnitude8.5 direction-cube candidates plus area-conserving diffuse, weak shutter-averaged scintillation
starField.license: Catalogue data/derivatives CC BY-NC3.0IGO, Credit ESA; ESA1997 SP1200, Hogetal2000 A&A355L27, CDS/VizieR DOI10.26093/cds/vizier; NASA background separate SVS4851 source terms
limits: NASA background and full atlas have independent visualization gains, not an additive layer calibration
HIP combined systems take precedence over all linked Tycho components; no coordinate-only merging
Magnitude/colour boundary differs from exact unpublished NASA generator; no claim of perfect1.7B-source reconstruction
Missing photometry/positions and effective Tycho->Johnson conversions are counted
Bright-star supplement18Yale audit still required; no false complete-as-NASA claim

night.ephemerisInterpolation: continuous endpoints; exact current EQJ rotation

limits: 8/6-point single-scattering quadrature, not a full multiple-scattering LUT
three-sample cloud self-shadow and ground shadow
bounded diffuse cloud bounce approximation
surface-parcel LCL estimate, not a measured sounding or cloud forecast
prescribed ascent and kinematic advection/entrainment; no Navier–Stokes solve
CPU density is the exact base-LOD density formula; view rays use filtered noise LOD
GPU budget must be measured on the actual renderer
